docs.summary: Lowers a parsed GLSL translation unit into a SPIR-V [`Module`](#api~Prowl.Prism.SpirV.Module). The growing heart of the backend; it covers the constructs implemented so far and throws a clear "not lowered yet" on anything new, so the unimplemented corpus is self-documenting.

members.name: Reset
members.signature: public Lowerer Reset(ShaderStage stage, SpirVVersion version, bool autoMapLocations)

docs.summary: Drop the references the last compile left behind (AST nodes, symbol tables, the lowered module's contents) once its words are serialized, so they are garbage during optimization instead of being carried (and promoted) through it. The next Reset re-arms the instance as usual.
